Viewed all six supplied screenshots. They show a two-column layout with Space around zones disabled, one 3840x1080 display at 100%, and arrow-marked thin strips above snapped content.

Current FancyZonesWindowUtils::AdjustRectForSizeWindowToRect compensates left/right/bottom margins using DWMWA_EXTENDED_FRAME_BOUNDS; it does not apply the same top-margin subtraction. That is a relevant comparison, not proof the missing subtraction is a bug.
Older open #2151 concerns one-pixel gaps between adjacent windows; its original report does not establish this newer top-edge/first-window scenario has the same cause.
